caption: The drawing shows a single, dark-colored object that appears to be a vessel or cup with a handle, elevated on a central stem, and situated within a matching round shallow dish or base. The vessel has a wide, open mouth with a slight spout, a thick, rounded handle attached to the side, and a turned, column-like stem connecting it to the base. The material is glossy and dark, appearing almost black or very deep brown, reflecting highlights of white and bluish tones. The object is centered on a plain, light beige background. There is a small inscription of the name "HENRY MORAN" near the bottom right of the base.
title: Grease Lamp
